name: Hampta Pass
region: Kullu to Lahaul, Himachal Pradesh, India

postcard.title: Rani Nallah
lines: The Rani Nallah joins you at Jobra.
You walk beside it until it disappears under the snow of Hampta Pass.
Cows and sheep graze its meadow, lined with maple and pine.

postcard.title: Jwara
lines: Just before Jwara, the path crosses a stream.
Jwara is a lush green meadow, with a couple of waterfalls in the distance.
Balu Ka Ghera, the next camp, sits among boulders below snowy peaks.

postcard.title: Hampta Glacier
lines: Climbing from Balu Ka Ghera, you spot the hanging Hampta Glacier.
It feeds the Hampta Nala, the stream you will camp beside at Shea Goru.

postcard.title: Top of the pass
lines: From the pass, the peaks of Indrasan and Deo Tibba fill the skyline.
Green Kullu is behind you now. The cold desert of Lahaul lies ahead.
Shea Goru camp sits beside a glacial stream, on a meadow dotted with flowers.

postcard.title: Chandra River
lines: Walking down toward Chatru, Inderkilla Peak rises on your left.
An easy trail runs along the Chandra River to Chatru, where the trek ends.

notes: Checked by the idea engine on 27 Oct 2026 against the live pages. Indiahikes: 'The Rani Nallah, which you will trek alongside till it disappears under the snow of Hampta Pass, starts accompanying you from here [Jobra]'; 'Some cows and sheep graze in the meadow which is lined with Maple and Pine trees'; 'Jwara is to the right of Chikha and can be identified by a couple of waterfalls in the distance'; 'Lush meadows at Jwara, a glacial floor at Balu Ka Ghera and a stream-side meadow at Shea Goru'; 'Balu Ka Ghera ... is nestled amidst boulders and surrounded by snow-covered peaks'; 'the hanging Hampta Glacier ... You spot it as you approach the pass from Balu Ka Ghera. It feeds the Hampta Nala, beside which you camp at Shea Goru'; 'From the pass, the sharp peaks of Indrasan and Deo Tibba dominate the skyline'; 'You have left the lush green Kullu Valley behind you. The cold deserts of Lahaul lie ahead'; 'The camp is set right beside a gushing glacial stream, on a green meadow dotted with flowers'; 'As you descend towards Chhatru, Inderkilla Peak rises to your left'. Potala Himalaya: 'a stream crossing just before Juara'; 'an easy trail along the Chandra River until reaching Chatru'; 'follow the left bank of Chandra River to Chatru where the trek ends'.
Camps differ by operator: Trek The Himalayas and Potala Himalaya camp at Chika (Chikka); Indiahikes camps at Jwara and treats Chika as a break spot. The app follows the Chika camp order.
Altitudes are left null on purpose: the sources disagree (the pass is 4,268 m in Potala Himalaya and 14,065 ft, about 4,287 m, in Indiahikes) and the app does not show them.
Spellings: Chika/Chikha/Chhika/Chikka, Chatru/Chhatru, Jobra/Jobri, Hampta/Hamta. The app uses Chika, Chatru, Jobra and Hampta.
Landmark kind 'glacier' is new: add it to the validator's allowed kinds.
Constellation names are app storytelling, not facts.
